status_legend.IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_REVIEW: All repository-side checklist obligations implemented with tests/evidence; only accountable-role review remains. Not PASS (checklist forbids PASS without that review).
status_legend.PARTIAL: Repository work done; obligations needing external infrastructure, hardware, people or approvals remain.
status_legend.MISSING: Requirement itself not delivered (only fail-closed guards added).

items.requirement: Assign an accountable owner and escalation path for Bulk data plane.
items.done: Roles, RACI, 5-level escalation, on-call, transfer procedure, CODEOWNERS binding, automated check (BLOCKED when unassigned/overdue).
items.open: Name people for all 5 roles; run and record escalation tabletop; bind CODEOWNERS handles to real groups.

items.requirement: Approve an architecture decision record for Bulk data plane, its technologies (Zero-copy shared memory), and its function (Avoid repeated host/guest copies).
items.done: ADR rewritten: options evaluated, ownership/lifetime/descriptor model, trust boundaries, copy-count contract, portability, default-on criteria, rejected alternatives, supersession.

items.requirement: Translate the source function of Bulk data plane — Avoid repeated host/guest copies — into testable SHALL-level requirements.
items.done: 41 machine-checked SHALL/SHOULD rows with owner, verification method, trace and evidence; copy-count SHALL measured (0 copies on shm path).
items.open: SHALLs for the host/guest path cannot be verified until that path exists.

items.requirement: Define functional requirements for Bulk data plane across cloud, datacenter, near-edge, and far-edge contexts where applicable.
items.done: Deployment-context matrix (supported/conditional/unsupported), edge profile with reduced limits, fail-closed host/guest.
items.open: CI/lab conformance runs on each claimed context (near/far-edge hardware, cross-host).

items.requirement: Define non-functional requirements for latency, availability, durability, consistency, isolation, or determinism as applicable.
items.done: Latency/availability/durability/isolation/determinism objectives with metric mapping; sandbox measurements.
items.open: Approval of proposed numbers; production-hardware evidence.

items.requirement: Define success, partial success, degraded operation, retryable failure, and terminal failure semantics for Bulk data plane.
items.done: Outcome classes and 25-code registry (retryability, attempts, new-id, progress disposition, caller action); classify(); state/outcome tests; embedding examples.

items.requirement: Define lifecycle states and legal state transitions managed or exposed by Bulk data plane.
items.done: 14-state machine, full transition table, idempotent repeats, exhaustive + random-walk tests, snapshot with last reason, restart reconstruction via recover().

items.requirement: Define versioning and backward-compatibility requirements for Bulk data plane.
items.done: Per-surface versioning policy, deprecation windows, golden v4.2.0 artifacts from original code, locked fixtures fail CI on change.

items.requirement: Define capacity ceilings, quotas, and fairness semantics relevant to Bulk data plane.
items.done: Global hard ceilings, per-tenant soft quotas, weighted fair admission with starvation guarantee, identity-bound accounting, throttle reasons, contention tests, capacity formula.

items.requirement: Define behavior when network connectivity is intermittent or absent.
items.done: Durable sealed checkpoints, reconnect handshake (MAC/age/epoch/object), GC and storage quota, receiver-wins conflict rule, flap/outage/stale/source-change tests, operator inventory.

items.requirement: Define precedence rules when Bulk data plane requirements conflict with security, residency, SLO, or cost constraints.
items.done: Versioned precedence policy, never-overridable security/residency/integrity, emergency override rules, conflict test vectors, CODEOWNERS review.

items.requirement: Enumerate every API, WIT contract, RPC, event, file, device, hypervisor, or control-plane boundary exposed by Bulk data plane.
items.done: 16-boundary inventory (trust, authn/authz, version, limits, failures, data class, ownership), API capability table, CI check that every public method and error code is listed.

items.requirement: Define authentication requirements at each Bulk data plane boundary.
items.done: Principals, HMAC capability tokens with expiry/skew/revocation/node binding/replay cache, identity bound to descriptors, generic failures, positive/expired/revoked/spoofed/replayed/wrong-tenant/wrong-node tests, audit events.
items.open: mTLS/SPIFFE/attested node identity for cross-process/host boundaries.

items.requirement: Define authorization and explicit capability requirements at each Bulk data plane boundary.
items.done: 12 explicit capabilities, deny-by-default on every call, tenant+scope binding, node-scoped admin actions require global admin, admin/data separation, descriptor binding, matrix/escalation/cross-tenant/revocation tests, audited grants/denials.

items.requirement: Define timeout, cancellation, retry, idempotency, and backpressure semantics for Bulk data plane.
items.done: Six timeout classes, cooperative CancelToken with LIFO unwind, registry-driven retryability, jittered backoff + budget, idempotent create/chunk/finalize/cancel, backpressure reasons, tests.

items.requirement: Define compatibility behavior when peers use different supported versions.
items.done: negotiate(): highest mutual version per surface, no auth downgrade, unknown mandatory refused, fixtures for v1 peer, rolling upgrade notes.

items.requirement: Document payload, concurrency, queue, connection, or resource limits at Bulk data plane interfaces.
items.done: Single limits table with kind, error code and validation order; unsafe combinations rejected at preflight; boundary tests; limits/utilization in health.

items.requirement: Provide reference examples and conformance fixtures for Bulk data plane.

items.requirement: Select and pin approved implementations, versions, or specifications for Bulk data plane: Zero-copy shared memory.
items.done: Selected and pinned stdlib shm implementation + ABI, capability probe, zero runtime deps, exact build pin, SBOM, pin CI check.

items.requirement: Separate immutable artifacts from mutable configuration and state for Bulk data plane.
items.done: Artifact/config/secret/state/audit/transient classes with locations and owners; state refused inside package; schema ids on every persisted format; artifact+config+policy digests in health.

items.requirement: Define declarative configuration and secure defaults for Bulk data plane.
items.done: INV37_CONFIG/1 JSON schema, typed units, secure defaults, unknown keys rejected, redacted effective config, negative tests.

items.requirement: Validate configuration before activation and fail closed on security-critical errors.

items.requirement: Support site- and environment-specific configuration without rebuilding immutable artifacts.

items.requirement: Record configuration provenance, version, author, and activation time.
items.done: Provenance record: digest, author, layers, source, package version, created/activated, previous digest; persisted history.

items.requirement: Apply atomic or transactional configuration updates where partial application is unsafe.
items.done: Atomic swap under lock, atomic file writes (tmp+fsync+rename+dir fsync).

items.requirement: Define automatic and operator-driven rollback for failed Bulk data plane changes.
items.done: Automatic rollback on failed health check, operator rollback, artifact rollback procedure.

items.requirement: Keep credentials and secret material out of ordinary Bulk data plane configuration and diagnostics.
items.done: Inline secrets rejected, key file permission check, redaction in config/logs/diagnostics.

items.requirement: Provide a deterministic bootstrap path from an empty node/environment to healthy Bulk data plane operation.

items.requirement: Apply least privilege to every identity and capability used by Bulk data plane.

items.done: Peers/control-plane actors authenticated by capability tokens; config and artifacts digested.

items.requirement: Verify signatures, digests, provenance, and approved versions for executable or policy artifacts consumed by Bulk data plane.
items.done: Zero deps, exact pins, SBOM with per-file hashes, source digest bound into evidence; policy file digested.
